entries.mechanism: Pinned policyengine-taxsim 2.30.0 was requested at 2026, but its Mississippi siitax grid has a 4.4 percent marginal slope while the canonical section 27-7-5 schedule applies 4 percent above the 10,000 dollar zero band. TAXSIM also independently constructs its filing-unit taxable-income boundary. For this case Axiom reports 468.00 and TAXSIM reports 490.64; the residual is external model vintage and boundary, not a RuleSpec computation.
